description: Angular component for managing auto-commit settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, service interactions, and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: AutoCommitSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring auto-commit settings related to version control in the Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form, loads existing settings, and sets read-only status.

methods.name: entityTypesFormGroupArray
methods.description: Returns array of form groups for entity types.

methods.name: entityTypesFormGroupExpanded
methods.description: Checks if a form group for an entity type is expanded.

methods.name: trackByEntityType
methods.description: Track function for entity type list rendering.

methods.name: removeEntityType
methods.description: Removes an entity type form group by index.

methods.name: addEnabled
methods.description: Checks if adding a new entity type is allowed.

methods.name: addEntityType
methods.description: Adds a new entity type form group.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all entity type form groups.

methods.name: entityTypeText
methods.description: Generates HTML description for an entity type.

methods.name: allowedEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns list of entity types allowed for addition.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes auto-commit settings after user confirmation.

methods.name: prepareEntityTypesFormArray
methods.description: Prepares form array from settings object.

methods.name: createEntityTypeControl
methods.description: Creates a form group for an entity type with configuration.
